deed_1_title: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him
deed_1_reward: A palm tree is planted in Paradise
deed_1_hadith: Whoever says 'SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi' (Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him), a palm tree is planted for him in Paradise
deed_1_source: Narrated by At-Tirmidhi, authenticated by Al-Albani
deed_2_title: Glory be to Allah the Almighty and praise be to Him
deed_2_reward: Heavy on the Scale of deeds
deed_2_hadith: Two words that are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: 'Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, Glory be to Allah the Almighty'
deed_3_title: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him (100 times)
deed_3_reward: Sins are wiped away even if they were like the foam of the sea
deed_3_hadith: Whoever says 'Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him' one hundred times a day, his sins will be wiped away even if they were like the foam of the sea
deed_4_reward: A palace is built for you in Paradise
deed_4_hadith: Whoever recites 'Say: He is Allah, the One' ten times, Allah will build for him a palace in Paradise
deed_4_source: Narrated by Ahmad, authenticated by Al-Albani
_comment_deed_5: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
deed_5_title: There is no power nor strength except with Allah
deed_5_reward: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise
deed_5_hadith: Shall I not guide you to a word that is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise? 'There is no power nor strength except with Allah'
_comment_deed_6: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadeer
deed_6_title: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things
deed_6_reward: 100 good deeds, 100 sins erased, and protection from Satan
deed_6_hadith: Whoever says it one hundred times a day, it will be equivalent to freeing ten slaves, one hundred good deeds will be recorded for him, one hundred sins will be erased from him, and it will be a protection for him from Satan
_comment_deed_7: Sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
deed_7_title: Sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
deed_7_reward: 10 blessings from Allah, 10 sins erased, and 10 ranks raised
deed7_hadith: Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him ten times, ten sins will be erased from him, and he will be raised ten degrees
_comment_deed_8: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him
deed_8_title: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him
deed_8_reward: Relief from every distress and a way out from every worry
deed8_hadith: Whoever persists in seeking forgiveness, Allah will grant him relief from every worry, a way out from every distress, and will provide for him from sources he never expected
deed8_source: Narrated by Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah
_comment_deed_9: Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi after every prayer
deed_9_title: Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi after every prayer
deed_9_reward: Nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death
deed_9_hadith: Whoever recites Ayat Al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death
deed_9_source: Narrated by An-Nasa'i, authenticated by Al-Albani
_comment_deed_10: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar
deed_10_title: Glory be to Allah, Praise be to Allah, There is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest
deed_10_reward: The most beloved words to Allah
deed10_hadith: The most beloved words to Allah are four: Glory be to Allah, Praise be to Allah, There is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest
deed_11_reward: His sins are forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea
deed_11_hadith: Whoever glorifies Allah thirty-three times after every prayer, praises Allah thirty-three times, and magnifies Allah thirty-three times
deed_12_title: There is no god but Allah
deed_12_reward: The best words spoken by the Prophets
deed_12_hadith: The best remembrance is 'There is no god but Allah,' and the best supplication is 'Praise be to Allah'
deed_12_source: Narrated by At-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah
deed_13_hadith: Purification is half of faith, and 'Praise be to Allah' fills the Scale
_comment_deed_14: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-Aleem (3 times)
deed_14_title: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing (3 times)
deed_14_hadith: Whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, nothing will harm him
deed_14_source: Narrated by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi
_comment_deed_15: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq (3 times)
deed_15_title: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created (3 times)
deed_15_hadith: Whoever says it three times in the evening, no poisonous creature will harm him that night
